title: an is_null() guard removes the null half of a nullable parameter

ground_truth.statement: is_null() is true for null and false for every string, so after `if (is_null($value)) return;` the value is a string and the call is sound.

notes: Regression guard: this is the plainest nullability narrowing there is, and all three analyzers are expected to be green. It exists so that the corpus can show a row where everyone agrees.
